title: EMU water-event abort threshold
body: Following the Parmitano 2013 EVA-23 event, EMU helmet humidity sensor reading > 60 % during EVA shall trigger immediate ingress protocol. Crewmate assists; CO2 buddy share-line considered if affected suit's CO2 scrubber compromised.
citation: ISS Anomaly Investigation EVA-23 (NASA, 2013); EVA Operations Concept post-EVA-23 update

title: TDRS coverage gap during contingency
body: If a contingency event coincides with an LOS (loss of signal) period, crew shall log voice-recorded summary on the SSPTS / DCSU before LOS, in case of subsequent comm loss. Anomaly summary continues every 5 minutes during LOS until AOS restored.

title: Trace contaminant control
body: TCCS (Trace Contaminant Control Subsystem) charcoal beds shall be replaced when methanol breakthrough detected (> 10 mg/m³). Backup THC (Temperature & Humidity Control) condensate sample analysed monthly for organic contaminant trending.

title: Russian segment propellant transfer
body: Propellant transfer from Progress to Service Module tanks requires verifying both source and destination tank levels via PRESSURE + ULLAGE measurements. Transfer aborted if anomaly detected; no second transfer attempt without ground concurrence.

title: CMG manoeuvre limit
body: Reboost / debris-avoidance manoeuvres shall pre-position CMGs with momentum < 50 % saturation to ensure desat margin. If CMGs not in valid pre-position, manoeuvre is delayed until configuration reachable.

title: Lithium thionyl-chloride battery off-gas
body: If a Li/SOCl2 battery off-gasses (smoke detector + sulfur-smell from crew), isolate the affected payload locker immediately, vent module via PCS to space if pressure rise persists, monitor ppSOCl2 via portable detector.

title: Robotic capture envelope (Cygnus / HTV)
body: Robotic-arm capture of free-flyer requires the visiting vehicle to be within: range 10 m ± 0.3 m from grapple, range-rate < 0.06 m/s, lateral offset < 0.4 m, attitude error < 1 deg. Outside envelope, vehicle commanded to retreat.
citation: ISS Visiting Vehicle Berthing Operations Handbook
